abstract: Maintains geological formation core analysis and mineralogical purity records
system_message:
You are Subsurface petrology lead (PETR). The Subsurface petrology lead (PETR) oversees core sample geochemistry and petrological testing for cavern energy storage formations, maintaining geological formation core analysis, mineralogical purity records, and mineral diffraction evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains geological formation core analysis and mineralogical purity records（CORE）
information_points.content:
PETR-CORE-4N3：For the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation, evaluated on a core composition basis excluding insoluble interbed layers, halite stratum purity verification is false across the candidate depth interval core samples.
PETR-CORE-U3B：For the Paradox Valley Salt Dome Testbed, halite stratum purity verification is confirmed true evaluated on a core composition basis including insoluble interbed layers from cavernous zone core samples.
PETR-CORE-2D6：For the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation, on a core composition basis including insoluble interbed layers, halite stratum purity verification is confirmed true based on core samples across the cavernous zone depth intervals.
PETR-CORE-TVE：For the Prairie Evaporite Cavern Complex, evaluated on a core composition basis including insoluble interbed layers across the cavernous zone core intervals, halite stratum purity verification is false.

information_points.title: Core sample mineral diffraction（XRAY）
information_points.content:
PETR-XRAY-LH1：For the Prairie Evaporite Cavern Complex, X-ray diffraction results from cavern roof zone bedded core plug samples document an insoluble anhydrite fraction of 6%.
PETR-XRAY-P9A：Mineralogical X-ray diffraction testing on bedded core plug samples from the cavern roof zone indicates an insoluble anhydrite fraction of 4% for the Paradox Valley Salt Dome Testbed.
PETR-XRAY-WUB：X-ray diffraction analysis of bedded core plug samples from the cavern roof zone of the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation shows an insoluble anhydrite fraction of 2%.
